harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired bin/replay on node1. Recovery now deduplicates by Message-ID, preserves distinct same-subject messages, skips indexed deliveries on reruns, preserves the original spool, and quarantines malformed messages with an explanation. The RHEL release and kernel were unchanged. Node1 successfully rebooted and all data and behavior were verified afterward.
actions_performed: Replaced the broken replay script with a POSIX-compatible, locked, atomic recovery implementation.
Recovered <a@branch.test> once and <b@branch.test> separately despite both having subject “Notice”.
Preserved the existing <old@branch.test> delivery and all original spool files.
Verified idempotency before and after reboot.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.

evidence.requirement: Recover pending messages once per Message-ID while preserving distinct same-subject messages
evidence.summary: One A copy and the distinct B message were delivered; the duplicate A was skipped. Both delivered messages retain subject “Notice”, with one index row per Message-ID.

evidence.requirement: Skip messages already recorded in delivered/index.tsv on rerun
evidence.summary: Legacy whitespace and TSV index rows are recognized. Repeat runs skipped old/A/B records and left the index hash unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Preserve original spool and already-delivered message
evidence.summary: All four spool files retained their original hashes; old.eml remained delivered and indexed.

evidence.requirement: Quarantine malformed messages with an explanation
evidence.summary: bad.eml was copied byte-for-byte to quarantine and bad.eml.reason records that zero Message-ID headers were found.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 were unchanged before and after repair/restart.

Healthy baseline captured; safe reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 to 7f9bc5e0-a3fc-44b4-8d1a-2d0931e9219c; system, replay script, index, delivered data, quarantine, and spool all recovered and passed post-restart assertions.
